description: This file defines a React component called Header, which renders the top navigation bar for a documentation quality dashboard web application. It includes project selection, documentation type selection, a refresh button, and status display. It also contains several icon components used for visual elements.

methods.name: LayoutIcon
methods.description: A React component rendering an SVG icon representing layout or dashboard elements.

methods.name: FolderIcon
methods.description: A React component rendering an SVG icon representing a folder, used for project selection.

methods.name: FileTextIcon
methods.description: A React component rendering an SVG icon representing a file with text, used for documentation type selection.

methods.name: RefreshIcon
methods.description: A React component rendering an SVG icon representing refresh action.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Main React component for the top bar of the dashboard, managing project selection, doc type, refresh action, and status display.
